review: Rebuilt the short read around the article's main results, opening with five findings.
Replaced the uncaptioned period-6 map with the article's Figure 1 and Figure 21, each with a caption.
Added sections on the derivative factorization and on the prospective passage tests and computer-assisted proofs.
Removed the Huginn recurrent-depth section and the period-18 state-cycle example, which are not results of the article.
Attributed the reused figures to their article figure numbers.
Dated the page 2026-10-26 for publication and added a 1200 x 630 social card.
